records.text: Viewer Roll Tide (identity unverified) wrote that they were an ER nurse working the October 1 Las Vegas tragedy nine years earlier and saw over 240 patients.
records.speaker: Roll Tide (viewer commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Will you pray for us?" It makes me so happy, and we will pray for you. And just know that the last weeks of pregnancy are no joke. You know, you just want to tap out, but you will make it through. Every day feels like a year, but you will make it through. Roll Tide writes, "Please say a prayer for all those affected by the October 1st tragedy in Vegas nine years ago. ... I'm an ER nurse that worked that night. We saw over 240 patients. No matter what we go through, God is good. He will get you through anything every day is a blessing.
